implementation_summary: Added styleHashes(html) and previewCspForHtml(html) in core sanitize.ts (sha256 of each style element's exact text; style-src 'none' when there is none; never 'unsafe-inline'). The page's meta CSP now carries the same hash. The getPreview route builds its CSP per response through previewHeaders(html). The route's duplicate image constants and PREVIEW_FILE are replaced by core's PREVIEW_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES, PREVIEW_IMAGE_TIMEOUT_MS and PREVIEW_FILE_NAME. The policy follows ADR 0036's updated wording (img-src data:). Tests added for the served hash, no-style pages, and absence of unsafe-inline.
tests_proposed: Browser check (Chromium) that a served preview renders styled under the new CSP with no violations
risks: The hash must match the exact style text; renderPreviewDocument wraps the CSS in newlines and the hash is computed over that text.
Removed exports PREVIEW_CSP (core) and PREVIEW_CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY, PREVIEW_HEADERS and PREVIEW_FILE (runner); no other users found in packages.
styleHashes is regex-based and meant for sanitised HTML only.
handoff: BE-604: import styleHashes(html) and previewCspForHtml(html) from @qa/core (defined in packages/core/src/audit/preview/sanitize.ts, exported by packages/core/src/audit/preview/index.ts). Use previewCspForHtml(snapshotHtml) as the /s/:linkId Content-Security-Policy per response. The runner also exports previewHeaders(html) from packages/runner/src/routes/audit-preview.ts (full Shared Link header set).
